title: [Application of the provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939, or any rules made thereunder to
text:
295. [Application of the provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939, or any rules made thereunder to

_vehicles and employees of the Undertaking.] Omitted by s. 7(b)_ _and the Second Schedule, ibid._
(w.e.f. 3-11-1971).
